limitations: One course and one seed; no statistical generalization or physical stock-car validation.
400 or1000 historical study scores are not directly comparable: manual drivetrain, prepared genesis and genome have changed.
Sampled margin and line merit are search diagnostics, not safety proofs; physical offtrack/collision checks still decide validity.
Clutch inertia/capacity are documented estimates. Clutch-active runs prove input availability, not a causal scoring benefit.
Smoke on40 repeats the first40 of paired on200 for four variants; 2240 counts actual scheduled evaluations, not independent discoveries.

reproduction.startup: Check in or build all prepared records offline first. The benchmark never searches for a grip seed at startup.
reproduction.sourceHashNote: Raw hashes reflect study checkout bytes; lfSha256 supports cross-platform text checkout comparison. Runtime signatures and prepared fingerprints must also match.

clutchPhysicalEvidence.method: 0.7 s straight-road paired physical integration, initial speed18m/s, full throttle; select the lowest gear >=2 whose initial engine RPM is <=70% of redline. Kick open0.25s then close8/120s; control clutch engaged throughout. Observes rear-wheel torque/slip, not complete drift-chain success.
limitations: Engine/flywheel inertias .45porter/.30M2/.22GR86 kg m2 and clutch torque capacity1.35 times peak engine torque are model estimates, not manufacturer verification.
Quasi-static loads; no dynamic roll, clutch temperature, wear or engine damage. Cumulative friction work is telemetry, not a thermal model.
Automatic launch anti-stall pressure and manual shift opening/ramp are driver aids; MT shift duration uses EV2 .45s model estimate. AT/DCT/EV physical drive behavior is unchanged.

Clutch friction is solved against implicit rear wheel forces. Engine output remains bounded by stock peak torque/power/rev-limit; transient clutch torque can exceed engine torque by transferring stored rotational energy.

mobileValidation.limitation: A real evolved clutch event and visible replay HUD were checked. This does not prove a fully connected drift.
